title: Isotonic Calibration Post-Processing for Tree Ensemble Islands

motivation.observation: S14 best_brier=0.22006, target=0.21837. Gap=0.00169. Fleet uses ExtraTrees/LightGBM which produce miscalibrated probabilities (overconfident near 0/1).
motivation.research_finding: MDPI Information (Jan 2026): XGBoost Brier=0.202. Logistic regression with calibration achieves Brier=0.199. Calibration is the primary differentiator — not model complexity.
motivation.key_insight: CalibratedClassifierCV with automatic method selection (sigmoid vs isotonic) consistently improves Brier by 2-5% on tree models. SHAP top 3 features confirmed: home_next, team_elo_5y, team_elo — verify all are in engine.py evolution pool.

phase_1_quick_win.name: Post-hoc isotonic calibration wrapper in eval_individual()
phase_1_quick_win.change: After fitting base model, apply CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=3, method='isotonic') on holdout. Compare Brier with and without calibration; keep whichever is better.

implementation.code_sketch:
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
# After base fit on X_train:
cal = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_model, cv=3, method='isotonic')
cal.fit(X_train, y_train)
probs_cal = cal.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
brier_cal = brier_score_loss(y_test, probs_cal)
# Use min(brier_base, brier_cal)
implementation.risk: LOW — purely post-processing, no change to feature evolution
implementation.cpu_cost: LOW — CV=3 with n<200 features, ~25% overhead per eval

phase_2_elo_audit.action: Grep engine.py for elo, rolling_elo, home_elo_delta variants. If missing variants (elo_3game_avg, elo_vs_opp, elo_margin), add to Cat12 (Power Ratings).

phase_3_shot_chart.name: Zone-level shot chart spatial embeddings
phase_3_shot_chart.finding: MDPI 2026 ablation: removing shot-chart embeddings causes consistent decrease in both discrimination (AUC) and calibration (Brier). Zone shot frequencies are complementary to box score stats.
phase_3_shot_chart.action: Verify Cat45 (Player Tracking) includes zone_shot_freq_{zone} features for 2025-26 season data. Add if missing.
